description: Source code for a Git checkout worker process, handling parallel checkout items, communication with main process, and command-line options.

methods.name: packet_to_pc_item
methods.description: Converts a buffer received from the packet stream into a parallel checkout item structure.

methods.name: report_result
methods.description: Sends the result of a checkout item back to the main process.

methods.name: release_pc_item_data
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a checkout item.

methods.name: worker_loop
methods.description: Main loop for processing incoming checkout items and performing checkout operations.

methods.name: cmd_checkout__worker
methods.description: Main function for the checkout worker command, parsing options and initiating the worker loop.
